pages.text: $(l)The ladder$()$(br)Defeat the $(thing)Naga$(), then the $(thing)Lich$(). The forest's curses lift as its bosses fall. An $(item)Explorer's Compass$() or a Twilight Magic Map points the way.
Dig $(item)liveroot$() under the forest floor. Liveroot, raw iron and a gold nugget make raw ironwood; smelt it.

$(l)The Steam Core$()$(br)Four ironwood, the Lich's $(item)Exanimate Essence$(), two bronze, a water bucket and a Bloomery. It opens Age IV, and you never need the forest again.$(br2)The $(thing)Aether$() is open too: a glowstone frame and a water bucket.
